text:
alyssa: Quick async standup — what I did: updated SDK quickstart README and added a tiny sampleapp that shows streaming.
Blockers: sampleapp failing on macOS M1 when building wheels (numpy/OpenBLAS).
Today: try a build-matrix fix + open PR with CI tweak.

kevin: Nice. Which PR? can you paste link? :+1:

alyssa: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — added streaming example + docs. The CI failing job is `macos-python3.11-wheel`. logs: ```ld: file not found: libopenblas.dylib``` Might be a path issue in the wheel build.

mira: I can take a look after standup. I fixed the quickstart env.md typo yesterday and pushed the snippet to staging docs.

jon: Heads up — options: set OPENBLAS_HOME in the build container or use a conda-forge wheel. I can test a Dockerized macOS-lab that simulates the build.

alyssa: @mira awesome, thanks. If you see anything, ping me. @jon — can you run the docker sim? If it reproduces, I'll update the CI job.

devex-bot: [CI] build triggered for branch feature/quickstart-streaming — job id 98823

kevin: I'll review the PR today. If it's just docs + sample, we can merge with a quick revert plan and follow up on the wheel fix as an issue.

mira: Also created issue to track the sampleapp size + caching: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/210 — added notes about asset caching and smaller model variants.

alyssa: Blocker reduced — @jon reproduced locally and suggested the conda-forge wheel approach. I'll push a commit in ~1h. Thanks all :raised_hands:

kevin: :shipit:

alyssa: End of standup.
